about.title: ABOUT ME
about.firstParagraph: I'm a passionate computer engineering student at Rumeli University, currently in my 3rd year. My journey began with a deep curiosity about how the web works, which has since evolved into a focused expertise in building modern, scalable web applications with React. I thrive on bridging the gap between complex backend logic and seamless frontend experiences to craft digital products that make a difference.
about.secondParagraph: I specialize in React and modern JavaScript, building everything from sleek landing pages to functional full-stack applications. As a Computer Engineering student, my approach combines technical problem-solving with a keen eye for design and user experience.
about.thirdParagraph: When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring the latest tech trends, diving into new developer tools, or seeking creative ways to solve complex engineering problems.
about.containerParagraph: My mission is to create digital experiences that are not just functional, but truly delightful—products that users love to use and developers love to maintain.
